description: The references section (default null = names nothing) — rows naming another world by document path (see WorldReference), echoed by world.references. No boot-time file-existence check; resolution is a consumer's job. OPTIONAL, for the SAME reason Rules is.

items.description: One row of the references section — a world NAMING another world by document path, the primitive a wall-mounted portal placement (or any future consumer) resolves against. Authored data only: a row asserts nothing about the named document's existence or shape at boot — resolution is a consumer's job, not this section's (no boot-time file-existence check).

name.description: The reference's own name — WorldSafeName-shaped, unique within the section.

document.description: The referenced world's document path (e.g. "dive.world.json"), authored verbatim.
